creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, 2026-09-28: "allow sidebar dragging resize".

The agent list down the side of the window has one fixed width (SidebarModel.widths), so a long pane name is cut off and a narrow window cannot give the panes more room. Dragging the list's edge should resize it, the width should survive a relaunch, and the list should keep a sensible minimum and maximum. The dividers between panes already drag (DividerView); the same feel is the target.
title: ↔️ The agent list's width cannot be dragged
